title: acrostichum pennula
intro: Acrostichum pennula, commonly known as the mangrove fern, is a plant species native to tropical and subtropical regions. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, and is also valued for its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Acrostichum pennula include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, Acrostichum pennula has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues.
